verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins is mainly a law firm, but it ships self-service software through LathamDrive, including a document generator and the Automated Convertible Note, so bulk processing is a fair question. Nothing in the evidence shows batch generation, multi-item actions or bulk workflows. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404, so there is also no programmatic surface that could support bulk automation.
